item.tib: khod spungs gshen gyi bsdus don gnyis ma mo 'dus pa'i yang snying sbrag sgrub
item.coloph: zhes ma mo 'dus pa'i yang snying sbrag sgrub khod spungs gshen gyi bsdus don zhes bya ba 'di ni rang skal gter gyi shog dril la sbrag sgrab 'dzab snying bsdus don zhig yod pa la brten nas kho bo gsang bdag tu 'bod pa bdag gis bon skal gyi ma mo'i rgyud gzhung kun nas dad mos stobs kyis bskul bzhin legs par bsdus shing phyogs gcig tu dril te ma nor bar bkod pa 'dis kyang bstan dang 'gro ba skyobs par gyur cig/
